internal.title: flagd Service Error Rate Spike and Escalation
internal.body:
At 10:50 UTC on 2026-11-08, an alert was triggered for a 100% error rate on the flagd service. Multiple diagnosis rounds were conducted, focusing on internal faults such as error injection, configuration errors, crashes, or dependency issues. However, no supporting evidence was found to confirm any hypothesis due to limitations in tool budget and available data. 

The diagnosis process included four replanning rounds, each refining the hypotheses but ultimately finding no evidence to support any specific fault cause. The incident was escalated to the on-call engineer at 11:10 UTC for further investigation. No recovery or resolution was confirmed at the time of escalation.

Next steps involve deeper investigation by the engineering team to identify the root cause and implement a fix. Monitoring remains heightened for any recurrence or related issues.

external.title: Intermittent Errors Observed in flagd Service
external.body:
Between 10:50 and 11:10 UTC on 2026-11-08, some customers experienced errors when using the flagd service. Our monitoring detected an increased error rate, and our team promptly investigated the issue. 

At this time, the cause is still under investigation, and we have escalated the matter to our engineering team for further analysis. We apologize for any inconvenience caused and will provide updates as soon as more information is available.
